descriptionChirho: The Nile River in Egypt, used as a proper noun (yeʾor as the Egyptian loanword designating the Nile specifically), including with various prepositions (in, into, like, by).
A river or stream as a common noun (singular or with possessive suffixes), often still referring to the Nile but used generically for a major waterway.
An artificial canal, irrigation channel, or broad watercourse, referring to the branches and man-made waterways of the Nile delta or similar engineered water systems.
